description: This file defines a custom exception class 'InvalidParamException' used within the OrangeHRM system, specifically in the API V2 module for handling invalid parameter errors. It extends the base Exception class, includes an error bag property, and provides methods to retrieve and set error details.

classes.name: InvalidParamException
classes.description: A custom exception class for invalid parameter errors in API V2.

properties.name: DEFAULT_ERROR_MESSAGE
properties.description: Default error message when none is provided.

properties.name: errorBag
properties.description: Associative array holding error details related to invalid parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the error bag and optionally custom message, code, and previous throwable.

methods.name: getNormalizedErrorBag
methods.description: Returns a normalized array with invalid parameter keys for easier client consumption.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the exception with an optional error bag, message, code, and previous throwable.

methods.name: getErrorBag
methods.description: Retrieves the current error bag array.

methods.name: setErrorBag
methods.description: Updates the error bag array with new error details.

methods.name: getNormalizedErrorBag
methods.description: Provides a normalized array format listing invalid parameter keys.
